data.case_title: Suspicious "invoice" from Grundstücksregister Online Service GmbH for a private property register entry
data.title: Offer disguised as an invoice for a private property "registration" (€498.00)
data.summary: Grundstücksregister Online Service GmbH, a private company, sent an invoice-styled letter offering a two-year "registration" of the property at Ackerstraße 26 for €498.00, with payment requested by 1 December 2026. The letter itself admits it is only an offer – a contract only arises if payment is made – and states the entry has no connection to the official German land registry (Grundbuch).
data.explanation: This letter looks like an official land registry bill but is actually unsolicited private advertising. The document itself says it is only an offer (Angebot) and that a contract is formed only if you pay; the "registration" goes into the sender's own private list, not the real Grundbuch kept by German courts. You do not need to pay anything, and ignoring the letter has no legal consequence since no contract exists unless you choose to pay. If you already paid or are unsure, you can contact a consumer protection office (Verbraucherzentrale) for advice. Keep the letter for your records in case the sender contacts you again.

key_facts.label: How the contract forms
key_facts.value: Only upon payment; letter is an offer, not a binding invoice
key_facts.quote: Dieses Schreiben ist ein Angebot. Mit Ihrer Zahlung nehmen Sie es an; ein Vertrag kommt erst durch die Zahlung zustande. Die Eintragung erfolgt im privaten Verzeichnis des Absenders und steht in keinem Zusammenhang mit dem amtlichen Grundbuch.

items.title: Decide on the disputed €498.00 'registration' invoice
items.action: Do not pay this invoice unless you deliberately want this private registration; it is not a legal obligation and is unrelated to the official land registry (Grundbuch).
items.consequence: Paying would form a contract for a two-year private, non-official register entry; not paying has no legal consequence since no contract currently exists.

warnings: This letter is styled like an official land-registry invoice but the document itself states it is merely an advertising offer for a private, non-official register, with no connection to the German Grundbuch; this matches a known German scam pattern targeting property owners.
No contract exists and no payment is owed unless you deliberately choose to pay; paying would lock you into a two-year paid entry of no legal value.
